text_block_list.text:
Together with Daring Heart, who wanted to get some rest,
we visited a seaside pool.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's just as refreshing as the reviews said♪
This is going to be fun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oh?
Is that singing coming from over there—

At the same time Daring Heart noticed something,
I realized it too... A beautiful singing voice
was drifting in from somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Tra-la-la-la-la-laaaaaan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just when I was admiring that lovely singing,
it turns out there was someone here first♪ Hi, everyone—

Just as Daring Heart was about to call out,
that was when it happened.

(VRRRROOOOOM!!
VRRRROOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—Warning! We have reports that an animal
has escaped from the nearby natural park!"

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text: “We are currently confirming the details of the situation. Please remain where you are until staff members come to guide you.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...An animal escaped, you say?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I don't know what kind of animal it is, but... Trainer, please don't leave my side right now.
choice_data_list: Ah... Let's make sure we don't get separated.
Yeah... let's be careful not to get separated.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, it's like a disaster movie...
Though I'd rather pass on experiencing it in real life.

Just as she said, this sudden turn of events feels like a disaster movie.
If this were a movie...

choice_data_list: (...Uh-oh, I have a really bad feeling about this.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
!
Look, over there!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Something is coming!
Something's approaching at incredible speed—

Looking where she was pointing, something brown,
round, and covered in fur was coming this way.
That familiar shape... That's—!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: A capybara?!
choice_data_list: Yeah! They're all hyped up right now, it's dangerous...!
Yeah! She's too worked up right now, it's dangerous...!

text_block_list.text:
My bad premonition was spot-on—!
Naturally, in times like this, the Queen is the first to be attacked...!

A capybara charged straight at us...!
This is bad, at the very least I have to protect her—

To protect her from the approaching capybara,
I stepped in front of her, but...
The expected impact never came. Instead—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――! What a... beautiful singing voice...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Even animals can tell, can't they...
just how beautiful this singing voice is."

Just as I was about to reply, "That might be true,"
the capybara's round body moved again...!
choice_data_list: Still, we can't let our guard down just yet...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But I'm sure it will be fine.
That's right—if we sing too, I know it will!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Just as the signorina says!
Come, let us all sing! Ah~~~~♪

Timidly raising her voice,
the singing took flight into the sky.
With a purity that seemed to wash away all anger and sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Affirmative.
The feelings of Neo Universe and the others... have been 'transmitted.'

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. It reached them precisely because we poured our hearts out and kept believing with all our might.

text_block_list.name: Nature Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you were over here...! I'm so sorry,
I've caused you so much trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A lost little angelo...
Hehe, I pray that you find your way home safely.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm so glad no one was injured♪
The capybara was safely rescued, bringing an end to the scene straight out of a disaster movie.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~, that was so much fun!
Even if a few little things went wrong♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was like something out of a disaster movie.
Yeah, it was just like a disaster movie.

text_block_list.text:
If before was a high school drama,
this time it's a disaster movie. Being with her
makes everyday life feel like a Hollywood film.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"In both a good way and a bad way.
Besides... Hehe, seeing that scared look on your face
today was quite the rare treat♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Her expression when singing so intently was wonderful too—
I got to see so many new sides of her!
choice_data_list: Ah, um, because singing was actually pretty fun!
Next time, I'll definitely show you what I can do...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know what you mean♪
It makes me want to sing again!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Trainer, let's sing that song from earlier again! Ah~~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
Well then, I'll hold you to high expectations!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'd love to see you active as that clever character again, like before. Fufu♪
